summary_1line: Nala learns dice from Rituparna, expels Kali from his body, and arrives in Vidarbha disguised while Damayanti senses his presence by the sound of the chariot.

image_candidates.scene_text: As Nala learns the science of dice, the dark spirit Kali bursts from his body vomiting poison and flees into a Vibhitaka tree.
Nala drives the chariot at incredible speed, the horses leaping like winged creatures as they race toward Vidarbha.
Damayanti stands on the palace terrace, straining toward the horizon as the thunderous sound of Nala's chariot echoes across the city.
